amendments.reason: The reviewer-medium on G0 (b)-(e), before any fit render: (1) stage 1 could not start, the search's labels had no form for the fixed 1x width; (2) stage 2's thin and receded families were searched as alternatives, not as the sequential components the draft's search procedure states; (3) part 1 pinned the live light 0.25 documents G1's seal replaces by design; (4) the rule gated a group on its admitted count, not its gate cells (charter Design, the landing rule). The G1 tools and the rule are fixed; part 2's pins follow them, and the record lets part 1's check follow the four part-1 sources the fixes moved and read the two documents at c152b89b. No content of either part changes.

G1 step 0, the charter's Decision Log 7 (ruled at 86c1b543, merged as 67a82a00), executed as part 2's second and final amendment before any fit render: (1) the side branch w45-g0-search-fix merged into w45-g1-refit (50be5c44: a content twin measures a point and never replaces its overrides, and the sweeps refuse a partial objective; 371d3f1c: both checkers validate the amendment record), its moved part-2 pins and part 1's declare.py and test_declare.py re-recorded, and amend-fit extended to accept this amendment once and then refuse for ever; (2) the grading's domain narrowed to the monotone range the isolation ladder showed, sizeHeavySecondShareFar2x in [-share, 0], in stage 1 and in the receded difference, checked by the fit driver on every point; (3) the 35-point share x width factorial from c05 as one coordinate step, through a driver option (factorialGroups); (6) the seal admits what the builder admits (the receded second-tap widths), and part 2 states the receded second widths inherited unless a point names them. Decision Log 7 items 4 and 5 are the charter's text and change nothing in part 2. Nothing else of part 2 changes.

rulings.1: a second amendment, final: the side branch's three tool fixes (w45-g0-search-fix 50be5c44, 371d3f1c) re-pinned, and amend-fit accepting this amendment once and then refusing for ever
rulings.2: the grading's domain is the monotone range: sizeHeavySecondShareFar2x in [-share, 0] in stage 1 and in the receded difference
rulings.3: the (share, width) factorial is the permitted full factorial: stage 1 runs the 35-point share x width grid from c05 as one coordinate step, through a driver option

from.unit: signed fraction of the deep mix, graded on farS (2x-anchored; 0 at dpr 1)

to.unit: signed fraction of the deep mix, graded on farS (2x-anchored; 0 at dpr 1)
to.jointDomain: sizeHeavySecondShareFar2x in [-share, 0], share the point's resolved active sizeHeavySecondShare, so the graded share + delta * farS is never negative at any span; [-1, 0] is the box the grid spans. Checked on every point whatever it moves (fit.joint_domain_failures): a grid point outside it at the others' current values is not a candidate, of a delta sweep or of a share sweep holding the delta
to.why: Decision Log 7 item 2, a narrowing to the monotone range: the isolation ladder (i) read checkerboard-8__rrect-lg__rest monotone in the delta down to -0.75 at share 0.5 and reversed at -1, where share + delta crossed zero and the signed share became an unsharp mask that adds the c = 16 structure back (claims 5.205 section 8 (i)); the isolation bar is met on this domain (md byte-identical, the thick cells monotone)

from.unit: signed fraction, a difference over the active document
from.domainRelativeTo: the active light delta at the stage-1 point: the receded delta is the active delta times a fraction in [0, 1]
from.gridUnit: fraction of the active delta (1 is the inherited value; 0 switches the grading off in the receded pose)

to.unit: signed fraction, a difference over the active document
to.domainRelativeTo: the active light delta at the stage-1 point: the receded delta is the active delta times a fraction in [0, 1]
to.gridUnit: fraction of the active delta (1 is the inherited value; 0 switches the grading off in the receded pose)
to.jointDomain: the receded delta, resolved, in [-share, 0], share the receded document's resolved sizeHeavySecondShare (its own difference where the point names one, else the active value); each key the receded document does not name resolves to the active value, so a receded share below the inherited delta's magnitude is not a candidate until the receded delta is narrowed with it
to.why: Decision Log 7 item 2: the receded difference on the same monotone range as stage 1

to.rule: on the c05 lineage the share and the width are swept as ONE coordinate step: their 5 x 7 grid in full, at the position of the share in the listed order, in place of their two single-leaf sweeps, in each pass (search.steps_of); a point outside the joint domain is not a candidate; content twins render once and every point keeps its own overrides. From the joint point the coordinate sweep is as before
to.why: Decision Log 7 item 3: from c05 (share 0, width 0) the share and the width gate each other (at share 0 the width is unread, at width 0 the share does nothing), so a coordinate sweep leaves (0, 0) only through the grid's first width; this is the 'full factorial permitted' of searchProcedure
